Does Brad Pitt die in Saturday Night Live?

He plays Dr. Anthony Fauci, a cameo role.

Want to guess first?

Revealing shows only the answer. Everything else stays behind its own curtain.

No.

He is alive when the credits roll.

How it happens, in words. No pictures yet.

Takes off the wig and thanks the real Fauci.

In the April 25, 2020 remote cold open, Pitt plays Dr. Fauci calmly 'translating' clips of the President's coronavirus statements, facepalming at the disinfectant and 'hit the body with light' ideas. At the end he removes the gray wig and glasses and, as himself, thanks Fauci and frontline workers. Nobody dies.

Earned Pitt an Emmy nomination for Outstanding Guest Actor in a Comedy Series.
